environment.policy: execution-v1; isolated Python; scrub application overrides; isolated Git

workload: One original scripts/benchmark_execution.py --worker invocation via runpy main, exact source and original gold helper copy; original worker report and exit semantics retained. No qualification sample, repeated capture, artificial stall or altered production retries/sleeps.
run_authorization_gate: Root must independently review exact runner and plan bytes/hash before invocation; --reviewed-plan-sha256 must equal actual plan SHA. This staging action does not invoke the runner.

observations.scope: io.open read-only streams and os.replace targeting the fresh fixture repository/.orqalis only; record actual open return, real close completion, every replacement attempt, exception and current matching owned handles.
observations.native_metadata: On PermissionError, read source/target GetFileAttributesW only; no file reopen, content read, ACL write, extra replace or sleep. Keep readonly/reparse bits and native metadata error if unavailable.
observations.flush: Memory buffer only during work; separate exclusive observations.json after delegates restored. Drop counters explicit; timeout can lose the final observation buffer and cannot establish no overlap.
observations.observation_limit: The io.open stream proxy delegates read/context/close/iteration but changes stream identity. Open time is sampled after open returns, close after close returns; failure snapshot cannot prove exact native share flags or external-process ownership. Untracked GC closure/direct builtin/C opens can evade this observer; absence of a matching owned interval is not proof of AV or host cause. Diagnostic overhead alters timing; no performance credit.

guards: Exact runner/original script/original failed report+log/source fingerprint/390 per-file input hashes+aggregate/original three helper hashes/fixture dataset/environment before and after; fresh exclusive output workspace, original worker import isolation. After-guard failures are recorded and do not overwrite the original failure sidecar. No deletion of retained new workspace.
retention: Original failed scratch is absent following TemporaryDirectory cleanup; do not claim retained original fixture. New fixed diagnostic uses a persistent owned workspace, raw worker.log, original worker.json if produced, observations.json and result.json. Original raw captures remain unchanged.
interpretation: A matching owned active interval at replace failure supports owned overlap but needs actual share-mode/duration corroboration; PASS with no observed denial does not explain or waive original failure. External ownership remains unproven without actual witness.
separate_optional_test_only_proposal: One native Windows owned fixture: hold an ordinary read handle with an explicit barrier through existing three replacement attempts (>60ms), expect persistent PermissionError/original bytes/temp cleanup; then close handle and make one separately predeclared write. This demonstrates a supported Windows sharing condition, not attribution of original failure. Do not inject this delay into the original worker or run it before separate review.
conditional_correction: Only after causal evidence: a small Windows read helper using replacement-compatible sharing (READ|WRITE|DELETE), retaining fresh path-link guards, one-buffer decode/strict JSON, locked writes, source identity/version gates and no external dependency. Review native flags/handle ownership/close/error behavior and tests independently before any production patch. Do not expand retries or add per-capsule state locks to every metadata read.
